ticket: #189 (spec #181): honest results, certainty labels and the rushing rule
note: Round named after the ticket so parallel tickets of spec #181 do not take the same r<n>. Savar was asleep: the implementer shipped option A of each look (most consistent with DESIGN.md and D-087/D-088) and lists the others so Savar can swap.
invariants: Copy from the spec: 'Take your time'; 'Clear' / 'Early sign: workbook 1 checks this' (waitlist families: 'Early sign')
Real components: TakeTest (test.tsx) and ReportCard (report.tsx), driven by scripted children through the real session and report model
No database or network: the test API was answered in the browser driver; the report came from a temporary page that was not committed

looks.decision: Where 'Take your time' shows on the test screen

options.name: Note above the question
options.bet: A calm white note with the orange marker, read with the question
options.benefit: Never blocks; same pane and type as the question; role=status
options.cost: A child who is rushing may skip past it

options.name: A screen before the question
options.bet: The split-desk message screen (like the break) with 'Go to question 4'
options.cost: One more click; feels like a telling-off if the run goes on
options.risk: Adds a step that the child may click through just as fast

options.name: A line beside Next
options.bet: The warn-colour line where the show-your-work nudge sits
options.cost: Reads as an error; seen only after the child has chosen
options.risk: Missed, and confused with the work nudge

looks.decision: Where the certainty label sits in 'By area'

options.name: Under the status chip
options.bet: A small mono line under each chip: filled dot Clear, ring Early sign
options.benefit: Keeps the D-087 table columns; works on a phone

options.name: Its own 'How sure' column
options.cost: Squeezes the meter; on a phone the table has no room

options.name: Inside the chip
options.bet: 'Developing · early sign', dashed outline for an early sign
options.cost: Drops 'workbook 1 checks this'; the chip no longer names one status

looks.decision: Where the reliability note and the new-test offer sit

options.name: First context note
options.bet: The help-warning card style (#71), first in the row under the band, with 'Start a new test' while a new test is open now; when the 30-day wait applies (D-108) it names the day instead (report-note-wait.png)
options.benefit: Reuses an existing report pattern; read right after the level
options.cost: Sits beside the FSA line on desktop

options.name: Banner above the band
options.cost: The report opens with a warning, before any result

options.name: Inside the band
options.bet: Under the ruler, in the colour band
options.benefit: Tied to the level it qualifies
options.cost: Yellow card on a yellow field; crowds the band
options.risk: Low contrast against the sunflower field
